axisMethod: Source-polygon interior axis fitted at road bends; not surveyed; normal cross-sections sampled at approximately 0.7 m.
modelNotes: Actual source road geometry; fixed 4.0m northern sidewalk model pending field survey.
Twenty-six public-map stationery/toy shop points are matched to twenty source building footprints; footprint area is not store interior floor area.
Shop access connectors are projected from public-map shop points to the study-road boundary and are not surveyed door-center coordinates.
Tiny clipping seams at A/C/D/M/J are locally bridged so mapped roads remain open.
Agents originate and depart only at exterior W/E/R/S ports, not A/M/J junctions.
Discrete spatial occupancy with assumed routes; no observed OD or calibrated pedestrian dynamics.
Study metrics retain the original A–M–J street footprint; approaches provide context and constrain movement.

networkSource.sidewalkMethod: Fixed 4.0m strip inside the source Jongno northern sidewalk-side road boundary, interpreted with the April 2026 road-view image; not an independently surveyed sidewalk polygon.
